name: Warlock

abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Power Burn: Hedeften belirli miktarda güç alır, ardından alınan güçle orantılı doğrudan hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): 3 etkili yol var: en az 3 farklı bonus taşıyan şampiyon, şok+zırh-kırmaya immün şampiyon veya Robot, ya da will-power yeterliliğini kaldırarak degeneration'ı önlemek.
signatureAbility:
Child of Kvch

immunityDetails:
• Kanama Bağışıklığı 🩸
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪
• Ani Soğuk Bağışıklığı 🧊

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Immune to Bleed, Poison, Coldsnap, and Frostbite.
His durable Technarch form grants Warlock a permanent Armor Up Buff, increasing Armor Rating by +[916.67]. If this Buff is removed for any reason, it will refresh itself after 10 second(s).
While this Buff is active, Opponent's Special Attacks cannot be Critical.

abilitySections.title: Contact
content: The Opponent gains a charge of Techno-Organic Transmode Virus. The Virus is not affected by Ability Accuracy.

Once the Opponent has 20 charges, they are removed and replaced with one Infection Passive that lasts for 20 second(s). The duration is decreased by 6 second(s) for each unique Buff on the Opponent when it activates.

abilitySections.title: Techno-Organic Transmode Virus Infection - Passive
content: The Opponent cannot gain Health. If the Salve Mastery is active, the Mastery is removed.
The Opponent has -30% Offensive Ability Accuracy.
Whenever the Opponent would gain Health while infected, Warlock Power Drains them for 5% of their current Power over 0.5 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Blocking
content: If the Block was Well-Timed, the Opponent gains 3 Virus charges.
If the hit was a non-contact Basic Attack, the Opponent instantly Drains 10% of their current Power.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Lacerate opponents, inflicting [9,474.35] Bleed damage over 5 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The last hit Shocks the Opponent, dealing [14,959.5] energy damage over 10 second(s). If they are Infected, this also triggers when the Attack is activated, but lasts half as long.
The first hit removes all Infections to Passively Drain 25% of the Opponent's Max Power over 5.5 second(s) for each Infection removed.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The last hit places two Armor Break Debuffs on Opponent, each reducing Armor Rating by [2,750] for 10 second(s). If they are Infected, the Debuffs also trigger when the Attack is activated, but last half as long.
The last hit refreshes one Infection.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a Passive Power Burn on the Opponent, draining 100% of their current Power over 5.5 second(s) and dealing damage proportionate to the amount lost.
Regenerate [5,390.44] Health for each Infection the Opponent has.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Child of Kvch
content: When the Opponent's Power is Drained or Burned, inflict a Degeneration Passive dealing [1,246.63 - 3,739.88] Direct Damage over 2 seconds.
